verses.arabic: يسٓ
verses.english: Ya Seen!
verses.transliteration_html: Y<u>a</u>seen
verses.transliteration_text: Yaseen

verses.arabic: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.english: By the Wise Quran,
verses.transliteration_html: Waalqurani alhakeemi
verses.transliteration_text: Waalqurani alhakeemi

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.english: you are indeed one of the apostles,
verses.transliteration_html: Innaka lamina almursaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Innaka lamina almursaleena

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
verses.english: on a straight path.
verses.transliteration_html: AAala siratin mustaqeemin
verses.transliteration_text: AAala siratin mustaqeemin

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.english: [It is a scripture] sent down gradually from the All-mighty, the All-merciful
verses.transliteration_html: Tanzeela alAAazeezi alrraheemi
verses.transliteration_text: Tanzeela alAAazeezi alrraheemi

verses.arabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ
verses.english: that you may warn a people whose fathers were not warned, so they are oblivious.
verses.transliteration_html: Litunthira qawman ma onthira abaohum fahum ghafiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Litunthira qawman ma onthira abaohum fahum ghafiloona

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.english: The word has certainly become due against most of them, so they will not have faith.
verses.transliteration_html: Laqad haqqa alqawlu AAala aktharihim fahum la yuminoona
verses.transliteration_text: Laqad haqqa alqawlu AAala aktharihim fahum la yuminoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَـٰلًۭا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
verses.english: Indeed We have put iron collars around their necks, which are up to the chins, so their heads are upturned.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna jaAAalna fee aAAnaqihim aghlalan fahiya ila alathqani fahum muqmahoona
verses.transliteration_text: Inna jaAAalna fee aAAnaqihim aghlalan fahiya ila alathqani fahum muqmahoona

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّۭا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّۭا فَأَغْشَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.english: And We have put a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, then We have blind-folded them, so they do not see.
verses.transliteration_html: WajaAAalna min bayni aydeehim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan faaghshaynahum fahum la yubsiroona
verses.transliteration_text: WajaAAalna min bayni aydeehim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan faaghshaynahum fahum la yubsiroona

verses.arabic: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.english: It is the same to them whether you warn them or do not warn them, they will not have faith.
verses.transliteration_html: Wasawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wasawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَأَجْرٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
verses.english: You can only warn someone who follows the Reminder and fears the All-beneficent in secret; so give him the good news of forgiveness and a noble reward.
verses.transliteration_html: Innama tunthiru mani ittabaAAa alththikra wakhashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfiratin waajrin kareemin
verses.transliteration_text: Innama tunthiru mani ittabaAAa alththikra wakhashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfiratin waajrin kareemin

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَـٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.english: Indeed it is We who revive the dead and write what they have sent ahead and their effects [which they left behind], and We have figured everything in a manifest Imam.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna nahnu nuhyee almawta wanaktubu ma qaddamoo waatharahum wakulla shayin ahsaynahu fee imamin mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Inna nahnu nuhyee almawta wanaktubu ma qaddamoo waatharahum wakulla shayin ahsaynahu fee imamin mubeenin

verses.arabic: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.english: Cite for them the example of the inhabitants of the town when the apostles came to it.
verses.transliteration_html: Waidrib lahum mathalan ashaba alqaryati ith jaaha almursaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Waidrib lahum mathalan ashaba alqaryati ith jaaha almursaloona

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verses.english: When We sent to them two [apostles], they impugned both of them. Then We reinforced them with a third, and they said, ‘We have indeed been sent to you.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ith arsalna ilayhimu ithnayni fakaththaboohuma faAAazzazna bithalithin faqaloo inna ilaykum mursaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Ith arsalna ilayhimu ithnayni fakaththaboohuma faAAazzazna bithalithin faqaloo inna ilaykum mursaloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
verses.english: They said, ‘You are no other than human beings like us, and the All-beneficent has not sent down anything, and you are only lying.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo ma antum illa basharun mithluna wama anzala alrrahmanu min shayin in antum illa takthiboona
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo ma antum illa basharun mithluna wama anzala alrrahmanu min shayin in antum illa takthiboona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Our Lord knows that we have indeed been sent to you,
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo rabbuna yaAAlamu inna ilaykum lamursaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo rabbuna yaAAlamu inna ilaykum lamursaloona

verses.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.english: and our duty is only to communicate in clear terms.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wama AAalayna illa albalaghu almubeenu
verses.transliteration_text: Wama AAalayna illa albalaghu almubeenu

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
verses.english: They said, ‘Indeed we take you for a bad omen. If you do not desist we will stone you, and surely a painful punishment will visit you from us.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo inna tatayyarna bikum lain lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minna AAathabun aleemun
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo inna tatayyarna bikum lain lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minna AAathabun aleemun

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Your bad omens attend you. What! If you are admonished.... Indeed, you are an unrestrained lot.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo tairukum maAAakum ain thukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo tairukum maAAakum ain thukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifoona

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.english: There came a man hurrying from the city outskirts. He said, ‘O my people! Follow the apostles!
verses.transliteration_html: Wajaa min aqsa almadeenati rajulun yasAAa qala ya qawmi ittabiAAoo almursaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Wajaa min aqsa almadeenati rajulun yasAAa qala ya qawmi ittabiAAoo almursaleena

verses.arabic: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًۭا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.english: Follow them who do not ask you any reward and they are rightly guided.
verses.transliteration_html: IttabiAAoo man la yasalukum ajran wahum muhtadoona
verses.transliteration_text: IttabiAAoo man la yasalukum ajran wahum muhtadoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.english: Why should I not worship Him who has originated me, and to whom you shall be brought back?
verses.transliteration_html: Wama liya la aAAbudu allathee fataranee wailayhi turjaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wama liya la aAAbudu allathee fataranee wailayhi turjaAAoona

verses.arabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
verses.english: Shall I take gods besides Him? If the All-beneficent desired to cause me any distress, their intercession will not avail me in any way, nor will they rescue me.
verses.transliteration_html: Aattakhithu min doonihi alihatan in yuridni alrrahmanu bidurrin la tughni AAannee shafaAAatuhum shayan wala yunqithooni
verses.transliteration_text: Aattakhithu min doonihi alihatan in yuridni alrrahmanu bidurrin la tughni AAannee shafaAAatuhum shayan wala yunqithooni

verses.arabic: إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.english: Indeed, then I would be in manifest error.
verses.transliteration_html: Innee ithan lafee dalalin mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Innee ithan lafee dalalin mubeenin

verses.arabic: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
verses.english: Indeed I have faith in your Lord, so listen to me.’
verses.transliteration_html: Innee amantu birabbikum faismaAAooni
verses.transliteration_text: Innee amantu birabbikum faismaAAooni

verses.arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: He was told, ‘Enter paradise!’ He said, ‘Alas! Had my people only known
verses.transliteration_html: Qeela odkhuli aljannata qala ya layta qawmee yaAAlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qeela odkhuli aljannata qala ya layta qawmee yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.english: for what my Lord forgave me and made me one of the honoured ones!’
verses.transliteration_html: Bima ghafara lee rabbee wajaAAalanee mina almukrameena
verses.transliteration_text: Bima ghafara lee rabbee wajaAAalanee mina almukrameena

verses.arabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
verses.english: After him We did not send down on his people a host from the sky, nor We would have sent down.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama anzalna AAala qawmihi min baAAdihi min jundin mina alssamai wama kunna munzileena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama anzalna AAala qawmihi min baAAdihi min jundin mina alssamai wama kunna munzileena

verses.arabic: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَـٰمِدُونَ
verses.english: It was but a single Cry, and, behold, they were stilled [like burnt ashes]!
verses.transliteration_html: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum khamidoona
verses.transliteration_text: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum khamidoona

verses.arabic: يَـٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.english: How regrettable of the servants! There did not come to them any apostle but that they used to deride him.
verses.transliteration_html: Ya hasratan AAala alAAibadi ma yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
verses.transliteration_text: Ya hasratan AAala alAAibadi ma yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.english: Have they not regarded how many generations We have destroyed before them who will not come back to them?
verses.transliteration_html: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni annahum ilayhim la yarjiAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni annahum ilayhim la yarjiAAoona

verses.arabic: وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.english: And all of them will indeed be presented before Us.
verses.transliteration_html: Wain kullun lamma jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Wain kullun lamma jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona

verses.arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَـٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
verses.english: A sign for them is the dead earth, which We revive and bring forth grain out of it, so they eat of it.
verses.transliteration_html: Waayatun lahumu alardu almaytatu ahyaynaha waakhrajna minha habban faminhu yakuloona
verses.transliteration_text: Waayatun lahumu alardu almaytatu ahyaynaha waakhrajna minha habban faminhu yakuloona

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
verses.english: We make in it orchards of date palms and vines, and We cause springs to gush forth in it,
verses.transliteration_html: WajaAAalna feeha jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin wafajjarna feeha mina alAAuyooni
verses.transliteration_text: WajaAAalna feeha jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin wafajjarna feeha mina alAAuyooni

verses.arabic: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.english: so that they may eat of its fruit and what their hands have cultivated. Will they not then give thanks?
verses.transliteration_html: Liyakuloo min thamarihi wama AAamilathu aydeehim afala yashkuroona
verses.transliteration_text: Liyakuloo min thamarihi wama AAamilathu aydeehim afala yashkuroona

verses.arabic: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: Immaculate is He who has created all the kinds of what the earth grows, and of themselves, and of what they do not know.
verses.transliteration_html: Subhana allathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu alardu wamin anfusihim wamimma la yaAAlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Subhana allathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu alardu wamin anfusihim wamimma la yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
verses.english: A sign for them is the night, which We strip of daylight, and, behold, they find themselves in the dark!
verses.transliteration_html: Waayatun lahumu allaylu naslakhu minhu alnnahara faitha hum muthlimoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waayatun lahumu allaylu naslakhu minhu alnnahara faitha hum muthlimoona

verses.arabic: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
verses.english: The sun runs on to its place of rest: That is the ordaining of the All-mighty, the All-knowing.
verses.transliteration_html: Waalshshamsu tajree limustaqarrin laha thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi
verses.transliteration_text: Waalshshamsu tajree limustaqarrin laha thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi

verses.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَـٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
verses.english: As for the moon, We have ordained its phases, until it becomes like an old palm leaf.
verses.transliteration_html: Waalqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta AAada kaalAAurjooni alqadeemi
verses.transliteration_text: Waalqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta AAada kaalAAurjooni alqadeemi

verses.arabic: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
verses.english: Neither it behooves the sun to overtake the moon, nor may the night outrun the day, and each swims in an orbit.
verses.transliteration_html: La alshshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu alnnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoona
verses.transliteration_text: La alshshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu alnnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoona

verses.arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.english: A sign for them is that We carried their progeny in the laden ship,
verses.transliteration_html: Waayatun lahum anna hamalna thurriyyatahum fee alfulki almashhooni
verses.transliteration_text: Waayatun lahum anna hamalna thurriyyatahum fee alfulki almashhooni

verses.arabic: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
verses.english: and We have created for them what is similar to it, which they ride.
verses.transliteration_html: Wakhalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkaboona
verses.transliteration_text: Wakhalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkaboona

verses.arabic: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
verses.english: And if We like We drown them, whereat they have no one to call for help, nor are they rescued
verses.transliteration_html: Wain nasha nughriqhum fala sareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wain nasha nughriqhum fala sareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.english: except by a mercy from Us and for an enjoyment until some time.
verses.transliteration_html: Illa rahmatan minna wamataAAan ila heenin
verses.transliteration_text: Illa rahmatan minna wamataAAan ila heenin

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.english: And when they are told, ‘Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, so that you may receive [His] mercy…’
verses.transliteration_html: Waitha qeela lahumu ittaqoo ma bayna aydeekum wama khalfakum laAAallakum turhamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waitha qeela lahumu ittaqoo ma bayna aydeekum wama khalfakum laAAallakum turhamoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.english: There does not come to them any sign from among the signs of their Lord but that they have been disregarding it.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideena

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.english: When they are told, ‘Spend out of what Allah has provided you,’ the faithless say to the faithful, ‘Shall we feed [someone] whom Allah would feed, if He wished? You are only in manifest error.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waitha qeela lahum anfiqoo mimma razaqakumu Allahu qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo anutAAimu man law yashao Allahu atAAamahu in antum illa fee dalalin mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Waitha qeela lahum anfiqoo mimma razaqakumu Allahu qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo anutAAimu man law yashao Allahu atAAamahu in antum illa fee dalalin mubeenin

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.english: And they say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, should you be truthful?’
verses.transliteration_html: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

verses.arabic: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
verses.english: They do not await but a single Cry that will seize them as they wrangle.
verses.transliteration_html: Ma yanthuroona illa sayhatan wahidatan takhuthuhum wahum yakhissimoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ma yanthuroona illa sayhatan wahidatan takhuthuhum wahum yakhissimoona

verses.arabic: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.english: Then they will not be able to make any will, nor will they return to their folks.
verses.transliteration_html: Fala yastateeAAoona tawsiyatan wala ila ahlihim yarjiAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Fala yastateeAAoona tawsiyatan wala ila ahlihim yarjiAAoona

verses.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
verses.english: And when the Trumpet is blown, behold, there they will be, scrambling towards their Lord from their graves!
verses.transliteration_html: Wanufikha fee alssoori faitha hum mina alajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Wanufikha fee alssoori faitha hum mina alajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.english: They will say, ‘Woe to us! Who raised us from our place of sleep?’ ‘This is what the All-beneficent had promised, and the apostles had spoken the truth!’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo ya waylana man baAAathana min marqadina hatha ma waAAada alrrahmanu wasadaqa almursaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo ya waylana man baAAathana min marqadina hatha ma waAAada alrrahmanu wasadaqa almursaloona

verses.arabic: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.english: It will be but a single Cry, and, behold, they will all be presented before Us!
verses.transliteration_html: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona
verses.transliteration_text: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona

verses.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.english: ‘Today no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be requited except for what you used to do.’
verses.transliteration_html: Faalyawma la tuthlamu nafsun shayan wala tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Faalyawma la tuthlamu nafsun shayan wala tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَـٰكِهُونَ
verses.english: Indeed today the inhabitants of paradise rejoice in their engagements
verses.transliteration_html: Inna ashaba aljannati alyawma fee shughulin fakihoona
verses.transliteration_text: Inna ashaba aljannati alyawma fee shughulin fakihoona

verses.arabic: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
verses.english: —they and their mates, reclining on couches in the shades.
verses.transliteration_html: Hum waazwajuhum fee thilalin AAala alaraiki muttakioona
verses.transliteration_text: Hum waazwajuhum fee thilalin AAala alaraiki muttakioona

verses.arabic: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
verses.english: There they have fruits, and they have whatever they want.
verses.transliteration_html: Lahum feeha fakihatun walahum ma yaddaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Lahum feeha fakihatun walahum ma yaddaAAoona

verses.arabic: سَلَـٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ
verses.english: ‘Peace!’—a watchword from the all-merciful Lord.
verses.transliteration_html: Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheemin
verses.transliteration_text: Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheemin

verses.arabic: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.english: And ‘Get apart today, you guilty ones!’
verses.transliteration_html: Waimtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waimtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoona

verses.arabic: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.english: ‘Did I not exhort you, O children of Adam, saying, “Do not worship Satan. He is indeed your manifest enemy.
verses.transliteration_html: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
verses.english: Worship Me. That is a straight path”?
verses.transliteration_html: Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratun mustaqeemun
verses.transliteration_text: Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratun mustaqeemun

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.english: Certainly, he has led astray many of your generations. Have you not exercised your reason?
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloona

verses.arabic: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
verses.english: This is the hell you had been promised!
verses.transliteration_html: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum tooAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum tooAAadoona

verses.arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.english: Enter it today, because of what you used to deny.
verses.transliteration_html: Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroona
verses.transliteration_text: Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroona

verses.arabic: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.english: Today We shall seal their mouths, and their hands shall speak to Us, and their feet shall bear witness concerning what they used to earn.’
verses.transliteration_html: Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboona
verses.transliteration_text: Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboona

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.english: Had We wished We would have blotted out their eyes: then, were they to advance towards the path, how would have they seen?
verses.transliteration_html: Walaw nashao latamasna AAala aAAyunihim faistabaqoo alssirata faanna yubsiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Walaw nashao latamasna AAala aAAyunihim faistabaqoo alssirata faanna yubsiroona

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.english: And had We wished We would have deformed them in their place; then they would neither have been able to move ahead nor to return.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum AAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyan wala yarjiAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum AAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyan wala yarjiAAoona

verses.arabic: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.english: And whomever We give a long life, We cause him to regress in creation. Then, will they not exercise their reason?
verses.transliteration_html: Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala yaAAqiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala yaAAqiloona

verses.arabic: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.english: We did not teach him poetry, nor does it behoove him. This is just a reminder and a manifest Quran,
verses.transliteration_html: Wama AAallamnahu alshshiAAra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrun waquranun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: Wama AAallamnahu alshshiAAra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrun waquranun mubeenun

verses.arabic: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.english: so that anyone who is alive may be warned, and that the word may come due against the faithless.
verses.transliteration_html: Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireena
verses.transliteration_text: Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireena

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
verses.english: Have they not seen that We have created for them—of what Our hands have worked—cattle, so they have become their masters?
verses.transliteration_html: Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahum laha malikoona
verses.transliteration_text: Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahum laha malikoona

verses.arabic: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
verses.english: And We made them tractable for them; so some of them make their mounts and some of them they eat.
verses.transliteration_html: Wathallalnaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloona
verses.transliteration_text: Wathallalnaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloona

verses.arabic: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.english: There are other benefits for them therein, and drinks. Will they not then give thanks?
verses.transliteration_html: Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibu afala yashkuroona
verses.transliteration_text: Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibu afala yashkuroona

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.english: They have taken gods besides Allah, [hoping] that they might be helped [by the fake deities].
verses.transliteration_html: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan laAAallahum yunsaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan laAAallahum yunsaroona

verses.arabic: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ
verses.english: [But] they cannot help them, while they [themselves] are an army mobilized for their defence.
verses.transliteration_html: La yastateeAAoona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroona
verses.transliteration_text: La yastateeAAoona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroona

verses.arabic: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
verses.english: So do not let their remarks grieve you. We indeed know whatever they hide and whatever they disclose.
verses.transliteration_html: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna naAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona
verses.transliteration_text: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna naAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.english: Does not man see that We created him from a drop of [seminal] fluid, and, behold, he is an open contender!?
verses.transliteration_html: Awalam yara alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: Awalam yara alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ
verses.english: He draws comparisons for Us, and forgets his own creation. He says, ‘Who shall revive the bones when they have decayed?’
verses.transliteration_html: Wadaraba lana mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithama wahiya rameemun
verses.transliteration_text: Wadaraba lana mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithama wahiya rameemun

verses.arabic: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.english: Say, ‘He will revive them who produced them the first time, and He has knowledge of all creation.
verses.transliteration_html: Qul yuhyeeha allathee anshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleemun
verses.transliteration_text: Qul yuhyeeha allathee anshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleemun

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
verses.english: He, who made for you fire out of the green tree, and, behold, you light fire from it!
verses.transliteration_html: Allathee jaAAala lakum mina alshshajari alakhdari naran faitha antum minhu tooqidoona
verses.transliteration_text: Allathee jaAAala lakum mina alshshajari alakhdari naran faitha antum minhu tooqidoona

verses.arabic: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.english: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them? Yes indeed! He is the All-creator, the All-knowing.
verses.transliteration_html: Awalaysa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu
verses.transliteration_text: Awalaysa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.english: All His command, when He wills something, is to say to it ‘Be,’ and it is.
verses.transliteration_html: Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu
verses.transliteration_text: Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu

verses.arabic: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.english: So immaculate is He in whose hand is the dominion of all things, and to whom you shall be brought back.
verses.transliteration_html: Fasubhana allathee biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wailayhi turjaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Fasubhana allathee biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wailayhi turjaAAoona
